review_candidates.title: Technical Support Engineer Brandmeldinstallaties
review_candidates.description: Haal jij voldoening uit klantcontact, troubleshooten en complexe tickets oplossen? Dan is deze rol iets voor jou! Als Support Engineer bij Hertek Safety ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt bij storingen of technische vragen over onze brandmeld- en ontruimingsalarminstallaties. Door de afwisseling in tickets en telefoontjes is geen dag hetzelfde. Dit ga je doen: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het aannemen, registreren en afhandelen van (technische) support vragen via telefoon en tickets. Je ondersteunt installateurs bij storingen, installatievragen en de inbedrijfstelling van brandmeldinstallaties. Er staat een test-opstelling van onze brandmeldcentrale op de afdeling, zodat je mee kunt kijken met wat de installateur ziet. Je begeleidt eindgebruikers bij het oplossen van storingen. Een piepende installatie of brandende lampjes? Jij weet hen gerust te stellen en loopt samen door het menu. Ook onze eigen service- en onderhoudsmonteurs kunnen jou bellen wanneer zij hulp nodig hebben. Je lost incidenten (waar mogelijk) zelfstandig op, je kunt hierbij terugvallen op onze online kennisbank en de ervaring van jouw collega’s. Niet alle storingen zijn op afstand op te lossen. Jij schakelt met de afdeling Planning of Product Management voor de juiste opvolging. Je houdt werkinstructies bij, voedt de kennisbank met oplossingen en deelt je ervaring met collega's. Zie je dat iets slimmer kan? Of een proces dat stroever loopt dan nodig? Jouw input is van harte welkom! Jouw team Je wordt onderdeel van een hecht en gezellig team van 5 collega’s. Het beste voor de klant en voor elkaar staat centraal. Op elkaar kunnen bouwen, een goede samenwerking, afstemming en overdracht is hierin onmisbaar. Je werkt ook nauw samen met de afdelingen Planning, Product Management en After Sales. Onze servicedesk is tussen 08.00 en 17.00 uur bereikbaar. Jouw dag start dus om 08.00 of 08.30 uur. De dag wordt afgetrapt met een gezamenlijk teammoment. Met een lekker achtergrondmuziekje aan, gaan jullie aan de slag met alle tickets. Dit neem jij mee Ervaring met technisch support, Zendesk (of vergelijkbaar ticketsysteem) en klantcontact per telefoon en mail. Of ervaring met brandmeldcentrales in de buitendienst en de wens om naar de binnendienst over te stappen. Je zoekt zaken op een gestructureerde manier uit. Je komt snel tot de kern van het probleem en weet welke route tot de oplossing leidt. Zowel telefonisch als per mail ben jij een rots in de branding: klantgericht, geduldig en behulpzaam. Je hebt interesse in techniek en vindt het leuk om hier in te duiken. Wij begeleiden je om onze branche, producten en diensten te leren kennen. Ook leer je door samen met collega’s tickets te behandelen of in opgeloste tickets te duiken. Dit vind je bij ons: Salaris van € 3.053,92 - € 4.432,10 bruto per maand, in lijn met jouw ervaring en vaardigheden 30 vakantiedagen per jaar (met mogelijkheid om 8 extra dagen bijkopen) Hybride werken: tot 40% vanuit huis, een thuiswerkvergoeding en een vergoeding voor het inrichten van jouw thuiswerkplek Een winstdelingsregeling en pensioenregeling Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,23/km (tot 40 kilometer enkele reis) Ontwikkelwensen? In overleg is veel mogelijk, ga het gesprek aan! Leuke activiteiten met collega’s, zoals een uitje met overnachting, een zomer-BBQ en Kerstborrel. Daar bovenop organiseert onze personeelsvereniging regelmatig extra activiteiten Een werkweek van 32 tot 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw wensen Over Hertek Safety Wij geloven dat veiligheid een recht is, geen luxe. Daarom zetten wij ons elke dag in voor een veilige leef- en werkomgeving. Als marktleider bieden wij innovatieve, levensreddende systemen voor brandbeveiliging, ontruimingsalarmering en noodverlichting. Van bewoners van een verzorgingstehuis, kinderen in een school tot gasten van een hotel of theater. We adviseren en verzorgen zowel de inbedrijfstelling als service & onderhoud. Ook bieden we opleidingen aan voor installateurs en gebruikers. Zo beschermen wij mensenlevens en beperken we schade. Samen zetten wij ons in voor een veiligere wereld. Doe je mee? Solliciteer dan nu!

review_candidates.title: Membership & Events Coordinator
review_candidates.description: Company Introduction The Business Executive Network (BEN) is a professional community of senior business leaders across Vietnam. Through curated events and initiatives, we help executives connect, grow, and thrive.   Role Summary We are hiring a Membership & Events Coordinator to join our small team in Lakeview City, Thu Duc City. We’re looking for a proactive, people-oriented professional who thrives on building relationships. The ideal candidate is genuinely interested in building a vibrant executive community, bringing warmth, organisation, and a service mindset to every interaction.   They will be the primary point of contact for members, ensuring strong engagement, retention, and a positive overall experience. The successful candidate will guide member onboarding and renewals, monitor participation, and proactively support members so they feel connected and valued. The role also includes coordinating meetings, speakers, and creating meaningful experiences for members, while working closely with the team to ensure smooth operations.   Key Responsibilities Member support & onboarding: Provide professional day-to-day support to members, coordinate new member onboarding and help ensure a positive experience from joining through ongoing participation. Member engagement & retention: Monitor member participation and engagement, identify opportunities to strengthen relationships, and coordinate timely follow-up to support retention and renewals. Executive meetings & event coordination: Coordinate the planning and delivery of executive meetings, roundtables, lunches and selected events, including schedules, agendas, registrations, guest requirements and logistics. Speakers, venues & partner coordination: Liaise with speakers, venues, partners and suppliers to confirm arrangements, requirements, supporting materials and other operational details. Membership & event administration: Maintain accurate membership and event information, prepare relevant documentation, track registrations and follow-up actions, and ensure key records are kept current. Event communications & promotion: Work closely with Marketing, Engagement & Growth to coordinate invitations, event communications and promotional activity for members, prospective members and the wider executive community. Internal coordination & follow-up: Work closely with the Chairman and wider team to coordinate priorities, respond to member needs, ensure actions are followed through and support the smooth delivery of membership and meeting activities.   Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who: Has at least one year’s experience in relationship management, membership services, hospitality, event coordination, or other client-facing roles Communicates confidently and professionally in English (written and spoken) Is organised and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through on commitments Is comfortable interacting with senior professionals and business leaders Can coordinate effectively with external vendors, partners, and speakers Is familiar with (or willing to learn) CRM systems and digital communication tools Has a proactive attitude, strong interpersonal skills, and genuine interest in people and community building Demonstrates good judgment, discretion, and professionalism when handling member relationships A degree (or working toward one) in communications, marketing, hospitality, business, or a related field is a plus   Benefits Exposure to a community of senior executives and high-profile events in Vietnam Real ownership of member engagement and events Opportunity to grow into broader leadership or strategic roles Collaborative, international, and growth-oriented environment   Important Notes Applicants must live within 40 minutes of our office in Lakeview City, An Phu Ward, Thu Duc City All resumes must be submitted in English Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted   How to Apply To apply, please send your CV to admin@executives.asia. Application deadline: Friday, 18th September 2026 We look forward to hearing from you

review_candidates.title: Materials Engineer
review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: Job Purpose The Materials Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all materials used in municipal infrastructure, transportation, roadworks, stormwater networks, and related construction projects comply with approved specifications, quality standards, and regulatory requirements. The role supports the planning, testing, inspection, evaluation, and approval of construction materials to ensure durability, safety, sustainability, and cost-effectiveness throughout the project lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Materials Inspection and Quality Assurance Review and approve material submittals for roads, pavements, stormwater systems, utilities, and related infrastructure projects. Ensure materials comply with municipal standards, project specifications, international codes, and regulatory requirements. Conduct inspections of construction materials during procurement, delivery, installation, and implementation stages. Verify quality control and quality assurance processes implemented by contractors and suppliers. Monitor construction activities to ensure proper use of approved materials. Laboratory Testing and Evaluation Review laboratory test reports for soils, aggregates, asphalt, concrete, pipes, geotextiles, and other construction materials. Assess material performance and suitability for project requirements. Coordinate testing programs and field sampling activities. Validate testing methodologies and ensure compliance with recognized engineering standards. Recommend corrective actions when materials fail to meet specifications. Technical Support and Engineering Analysis Provide technical advice on material selection, performance, and lifecycle considerations. Investigate material failures, defects, and quality-related issues. Conduct technical evaluations and root-cause analysis of material performance problems. Support value engineering initiatives by identifying alternative materials and solutions. Assist project teams in resolving engineering and material-related challenges. Project Coordination Coordinate with consultants, contractors, suppliers, and testing laboratories regarding material approvals and quality issues. Participate in project meetings and technical reviews. Monitor compliance with approved material specifications throughout project execution. Support project delivery by ensuring timely review and approval of material submissions. Standards, Compliance, and Documentation Maintain records of material approvals, inspections, testing results, and compliance reports. Ensure adherence to municipal regulations, engineering specifications, environmental requirements, and industry standards. Contribute to the development and updating of material specifications, quality procedures, and technical guidelines. Prepare technical reports and recommendations related to material performance and quality assurance. Improvement and Innovation Monitor developments in construction materials, sustainable technologies, and industry best practices. Evaluate innovative materials and products for potential municipal applications. Support initiatives aimed at improving infrastructure durability, sustainability, and lifecycle performance. Participate in knowledge-sharing and continuous improvement programs. Qualifications Education Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Materials Engineering, Construction Engineering, or a related discipline. Professional Certifications (Preferred) Professional Engineer (PE) or equivalent certification. Relevant certifications in material testing, pavement engineering, quality management, or construction materials. Membership in recognized engineering institutions is preferred. Experience 5-8 years of relevant experience in materials engineering, quality assurance, or construction supervision. Experience in municipal infrastructure, roadworks, highways, stormwater networks, and transportation projects. Experience reviewing laboratory testing and material compliance reports. Knowledge of asphalt, concrete, aggregate, soil, and utility construction materials. Technical Competencies Construction Materials Engineering Pavement Materials and Asphalt Technology Concrete Technology Geotechnical and Soil Materials Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) Material Testing and Evaluation Municipal Infrastructure Standards Stormwater and Drainage Systems Engineering Specifications and Standards Root Cause Analysis Technical Report Writing Risk Assessment and Mitigation Value Engineering AutoCAD and Engineering Software (Preferred) MS Office Applications Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Percentage of material submissions reviewed within approved timelines. Compliance rate of approved construction materials. Reduction in material-related non-conformance incidents. Timeliness of laboratory test report reviews. Number of quality issues resolved successfully. Accuracy and completeness of inspection and compliance reports. Contractor compliance with material specifications. Contribution to value engineering and material optimization initiatives. Effectiveness of corrective action implementation. Stakeholder satisfaction with materials engineering support. Job Challenges Managing multiple projects and material approvals simultaneously. Ensuring compliance across diverse contractors and suppliers. Addressing material failures and quality concerns under tight project schedules. Keeping abreast of evolving industry standards and technologies. Balancing cost efficiency with quality, durability, and sustainability requirements. Resolving technical disputes related to material specifications and testing outcomes. Ensuring consistency of quality standards across various infrastructure projects.
